core_obligations: Construction (proof lines 6197-6213): given absolute glueing data the author defines the value at an object and the restriction maps by a displayed diagram, uses the compatibility condition to see that this is a presheaf and that the transition maps become isomorphisms onto the restrictions of the sheaf to the localized sites.

The sheaf property and the quasi-inverse (proof lines 6213-6217): since the pieces are sheaves the constructed presheaf is a sheaf, and the author states that the construction is quasi-inverse to the functor sending a sheaf to its canonical glueing data, noting that further details are omitted.
proof_roadmap: Construct the value and the restriction maps from the glueing data.
Use the compatibility condition to get a presheaf and isomorphisms onto the local restrictions.
Conclude the sheaf property and record the quasi-inverse.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the category of sheaves on a site is equivalent to the category of absolute glueing data (statement lines 6187-6194). The proof is a complete construction: the value at an object and the restriction maps are defined by a displayed diagram, the compatibility condition makes this a presheaf and turns the transition maps into isomorphisms onto the local restrictions (proof lines 6197-6213); since the pieces are sheaves the constructed presheaf is a sheaf (proof lines 6213-6215); and the author records that the construction is quasi-inverse to the canonical glueing functor, with the closing note that further details are omitted (proof lines 6215-6217). The non-formal content is the construction and the use of the compatibility condition. The claim is H2: a construction with the closing verification noted.
